t: What Geothermal Enhanced Deep-Well Systems Is
title: What Geothermal Enhanced Deep-Well Systems Is
provenance: Public research knowledge: documented developments, published research, and established technical references. Real, fact-checked records.
description: Enhanced geothermal systems (EGS) create artificial reservoirs in hot dry rock: deep wells fracture the rock, water circulates through the fractures, and returns as steam to make power — geothermal energy anywhere, not just volcanic zones. This record is the entry point of the teaching ladder for Geothermal Enhanced Deep-Well Systems: start here, then move through the research state, the specifications, the public developments, the open challenges, and finally each piece needed to build it.
key_points: Geothermal Enhanced Deep-Well Systems in one line: Enhanced geothermal systems (EGS) create artificial reservoirs in hot dry rock: deep wells fracture the rock, water circulates through the fractures, and returns as steam to make power — geothermal energy anywhere, not just volcanic zones.
Why it matters: EGS unlocks geothermal's 24/7 clean power across continents, not just in volcanic hotspots..
Where it is used: baseload clean power, district heating, industrial heat..
Ladder rank 1 — the foundation. Everything else builds on this.
